BC_description: The `signal` option in the `execa` function has been renamed to `cancelSignal` to better reflect its purpose in canceling subprocess execution. Additionally, passing the old `signal` option will now throw an error to enforce migration and prevent usage of the deprecated name.
Adaptation_method:
Rename the `signal` option to `cancelSignal` in all `execa` calls. Attempting to use `signal` will now throw an error.

Before:
```js
await execa('node', ['file.js'], { signal: abortController.signal });
```

After:
```js
await execa('node', ['file.js'], { cancelSignal: abortController.signal });
```
